run_evaluation_single_gpu: run the flow matching text model evaluation on a single GPU with a specified work directory
run_evaluation_multi_gpu: run the flow matching text model evaluation across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn
run_elbo_evaluation: run the ELBO evaluation on wikitext103 data with configurable batch size and sampling steps
run_perplexity_evaluation: run the perplexity evaluation with configurable sampling steps and number of samples
run_evaluation_with_seed: run the flow matching text model evaluation with a fixed random seed for reproducibility
